questions.prediction: Before running each probe or revealing practice feedback, save predicted bytes/decoded values, two competing interpretations and the observation that would separate them. Save results later, with discrepancies.
questions.layout: Before checker access, save your inspector, field map (offset, width, signedness and evidence for every field), envelope relation and unknown byte ranges. Preserve failed and repaired code in distinct records.
questions.transfer: Before opening transfer.trail or native read output, predict where your model may fail. Decode it, explain nonzero unexplained bytes and compare at least two new native-generated files with your earlier predictions.
questions.handoff: Preserve final source, format note, finite-check output, remaining unknowns and assistance. Export and resume without changing earlier records. State what M4 may rely on and what remains a hypothesis.
